question: Which playback singer was honoured with the Nightingale of Asia Award in 1987?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Asha Bhosle**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Asha Bhosle is a renowned playback singer in India, known for her versatile voice and extensive career in the Indian music industry.
 
• She has been honored with numerous awards and accolades, including the Nightingale of Asia Award in 1987.
 
• Asha Bhosle is the sister of the legendary playback singer Lata Mangeshkar, and together, they have made significant contributions to Indian music.
 
• Her career spans over seven decades, during which she has recorded songs for films, albums, and live performances, making her one of the most prolific singers in the world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Playback Singing**

 
 
• Playback singing is a technique in Indian cinema where the singing voice is pre-recorded for use in movies, and the actors lip-sync to the songs on screen.
 
• This practice allows for professional singers to provide high-quality vocal performances, while actors focus on their acting and on-screen presence.
 
 
 
• **Awards in the Music Industry**
 
 
• Music awards are given to recognize and honor achievements in the music industry, including performances, compositions, and contributions to the field.
 
• Notable music awards include the Grammy Awards, the Academy Awards (Oscars) for Best Original Song, and national awards like the Filmfare Awards in India.
 
 
 
• **Contribution of Asha Bhosle**
 
 
• Asha Bhosle has sung in multiple languages, including Hindi, Marathi, Bengali, Gujarati, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu, and many more.
 
• She is known for her versatility in singing various genres, including pop, classical, ghazals, and folk songs.
 
• Her collaborations with music directors like R.D. Burman, O.P. Nayyar, and A.R. Rahman have resulted in some of the most iconic songs in Indian cinema.
 
 
 
• **The Nightingale of Asia Award**
 
 
• The Nightingale of Asia Award is an honor given to exceptional singers who have made significant contributions to the music industry in Asia.
 
• It recognizes the impact and influence of the recipient's work on the music culture of the region.
